## Message

```
error X18N4008: Invalid edit input: <detail>
  Check the input shape against the docs.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

The input of an edit has the wrong shape.

- `x18n set` needs `--value <text>` (or `--value -` to read stdin).
- `x18n apply` needs JSON in the shape `{ "<locale>": { "<key>": "<value>" } }`. Values are strings, numbers, booleans or `null`.
- `x18n extract --apply` needs a plan file written by `x18n extract --plan`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
